title: Chapter 2 · AI Mock 1
instructions: Original AI-authored challenging practice inspired by topics and style in the available teacher quizzes. Not a teacher paper or official mark scheme. Work independently under timed conditions; self-mark against the model points after submission.
description: Timed teacher-inspired mock with written answers and model marking points.

questions.text: Explain how packet switching allows a file to travel across a network.

answer.text: The file is split into addressed packets
Sequence numbers allow reassembly and missing packets may be requested again

questions.text: Compare circuit switching and packet switching for a voice call.

answer.text: Circuit switching reserves a dedicated path for the session
Packet switching shares links and routes individual packets
Packet delivery may be delayed or arrive out of order

questions.text: Describe how a browser uses DNS before requesting a page.

answer.text: The domain name is resolved to an IP address
The browser connects to the server at that address
It sends an HTTP or HTTPS request

questions.text: Explain the roles of a switch and a router.

answer.text: A switch forwards frames within a LAN using MAC addresses
A router forwards packets between IP networks
